record.original_question: Is the space BΓn is n + 1-connected?

evidence.quote: Question 9.8. Is the space BΓn is n + 1-connected?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma_n$ denote the Haefliger groupoid of germs of local $C^\infty$-diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{R}^n$, and let $B\Gamma_n$ be its classifying space (which classifies codimension-$n$ Haefliger structures on topological spaces). It is a classical theorem of Haefliger (and refined by Mather–Thurston) that $B\Gamma_n$ is $n$-connected, i.e. $\pi_i(B\Gamma_n)=0$ for $1\le i\le n$.

Determine whether $B\Gamma_n$ is $(n+1)$-connected; equivalently, decide whether $\pi_{n+1}(B\Gamma_n) = 0$ for every integer $n\ge 1$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is the Haefliger conjecture (sometimes called the Haefliger–Thurston conjecture) on the connectivity of $B\Gamma_n$ in the smooth ($C^\infty$) setting. In the $C^r$ category with $r\ne n,n+1$, related connectivity results are known, and Meigniez (arXiv:2103.13897, 2021) announced a proof for framed Haefliger structures of codimension $q$ showing $(2q-1)$-connectivity. The full smooth Haefliger conjecture asserting $(n+1)$-connectivity of $B\Gamma_n$ for all $n$ is generally regarded as still open.

status_evidence.title: On the Haefliger-Thurston conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: The classifying space for the framed Haefliger structures of codimension q and class C^r is (2q-1)-connected, for 1<=r<=infinity.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work by Meigniez addresses connectivity of BΓ-type classifying spaces; the smooth Haefliger conjecture on (n+1)-connectivity of BΓ_n remains a central open/partially resolved question.

status_evidence.title: On flat manifold bundles and the connectivity of Haefliger's classifying spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of the Haefliger-Thurston conjecture and connectivity of BΓ_n.
status_evidence.claim: The (n+1)-connectivity of BΓ_n is treated as a still-open conjecture in current literature.
